[D4] Fact: Only ATP (Austrian Post) numbers are validated, as UPU S10 incl. mod-11 check digit. All other carriers: any non-empty value. Reason: their formats change too often; last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for two days.

- Austrian public holidays are a hardcoded list in src/services/holidays.ts, 2026+2027 only (list must be extended before 2028; other years silently get no holidays) — because the deployment has no outbound internet. (user)
